predict_musyc_surface

Source: R/musyc_fit_fn.R
predict_musyc_surface.Rd

Response of a fitted MuSyC surface (gamma12 = gamma21 = 1) at the given concentrations, e.g. to compare a musyc_fit_fn fit with the measured grid.

Usage

predict_musyc_surface(conc, conc_2, params)

Arguments

conc, conc_2

numeric vectors of the same length; concentrations of drug 1 and drug 2.

params

named list or one-row data.table with E0, E1, E2, E3, h1, h2, C1, C2, alpha12 and alpha21, as returned by musyc_fit_fn.

Value

Numeric vector of responses, one per concentration pair.

See also

musyc_fit_fn

Examples

params <- list(E0 = 1, E1 = 0.4, E2 = 0.3, E3 = -0.2, h1 = 1.2, h2 = 0.9,
               C1 = 0.5, C2 = 0.2, alpha12 = 3, alpha21 = 0.5)
predict_musyc_surface(c(0, 0.1, 1), c(0, 1, 1), params)
#> [1] 1.0000000 0.3891412 0.1064444
